bundle.longDescription: Benchtop gathers 429 developer, engineering, design and everyday utilities in one desktop app: formatters, converters, encoders, hashes, keys and JWTs, text comparison, network and DevOps helpers, diagram editors and file viewers, CSS, colour and image tools, app icons and other design tools for Android, iOS and KaiOS, print tools, Pitman shorthand and braille, AI image and speech tools that run on your computer, a Recipe tool with all of CyberChef's operations, PDF tools including a reader that annotates, form filling, signing and comparison, a file converter for video, audio, documents, e-mails, e-books and archives using the programs you have installed, a circuit simulator that runs Arduino, ATtiny85, Raspberry Pi Pico and ESP32 firmware, simulation labs for mechanics, waves, optics, geometry, genetics and biology, worksheets and solvers that show their working, a code runner, flipbooks, text to speech and video dubbing, notes with sketches and mind maps, data, science and map tools, bulk file tools, a unit converter for every trade and science, steam tables, a beam calculator, a library of about 300 calculators, plugins, and a command line. Everything works offline except the online checks, Web Page to PDF and PDF timestamps, which contact only the hosts you enter when you ask, AI models, which are downloaded once when you first choose them, and Check for updates, which asks GitHub for the newest version when you press it.
